chunks: Aban narrated from Muhammad al-Halabi, who said:
I asked him about a man who shoots at game and brings it down, then the people rush to it and cut it up. He said: "Eat it."

key_terms.الرَّجُلِ: the man being asked about in the legal case
key_terms.فَيَصْرَعُهُ: brings it down or fells it
key_terms.كُلْهُ: eat it; a ruling of permissibility
key_terms.يَرْمِي: shoots or throws at, referring here to hunting

ai.seo_question: Is game lawful to eat if it is shot down and then people rush to cut it up?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning hunted game that has been struck and brought down by a hunter. It indicates the permissibility of eating such game even if people quickly reach it and cut it up afterward.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4141 - Aban narrated from Muhammad Al-Halabi who said:

I asked Imam (as) about a man who shoots at game and brings it down, then the people rush to it and cut it up.
Imam (as) said: "Eat it."
